title: The Best Z-Wave Range Extenders
subtitle: Z-Wave repeaters that strengthen a weak mesh, ranked.
intro: We pulled the Z-Wave range extenders on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: 800 Series and Long Range support, and a pass-through outlet.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

scoring.review_age_weighting: Listings under 24 months old with at least 30 reviews have their review count multiplied by min(2, 24 / age in months, age floored at 6) before scoring; older listings are unchanged. Listing age is Amazon's Date First Available, or an estimate from the ASIN when the listing does not show it.

buyers_guide.q: Do I need a range extender?
buyers_guide.a: If devices far from your hub drop off or respond slowly, yes. Every plug-in Z-Wave or Zigbee device already repeats, but a dedicated extender is cheap and can sit exactly where the mesh is weak.
Halfway between the hub and the devices that drop out, on an outlet that's always powered.

buyers_guide.q: Does it work with any hub?
buyers_guide.a: Z-Wave extenders work with any Z-Wave controller in your region. Zigbee repeaters work with most Zigbee hubs, but some only repeat for their own brand's devices.
